# Codex folder-access screenshot transcription

`codex_folder_access_screen.txt` transcribes the visible text of the user's screenshot
reported on 2026-10-31. The CLI version is unknown. This is not a raw PTY capture:
terminal escape sequences, positioning and clipped text at the right edge are not available.
The first and third body lines therefore contain only their visible complete words.
The heading, question, both options, cursor and footer are fully visible in the screenshot.

Tests also replay the existing Codex 0.161.0 PTY captures, including the hook-review
near miss, and derive cursor movement and incomplete/quoted text from this transcription.
